scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @flagship/api" "npm run dev -w @flagship/web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck -w @flagship/shared && npm run build -w @flagship/api && npm run build -w @flagship/mcp && npm run build -w @flagship/web && npm run typecheck -w @flagship/infra
scripts.test: npm test -w @flagship/api && npm test -w @flagship/mcp && npm test -w @flagship/web && npm test -w @flagship/infra
